item.title: Installation
item.description:
Video Tutorial

Before Installation

Prerequisites

  • Thingsee Gateway is installed and operational (LED blinking green)
  • Installation surface is clean and dry
  • Plan sensor locations to maintain mesh network coverage

Network Coverage

  • Maximum distance: 20m between sensors or to gateway
  • Use intermediate sensors as routers for distances > 20m
  • Account for signal attenuation from fire doors, thick walls, metal structures, and dense building materials

Sensor Capabilities

Thingsee BEAM measures the distance between the sensor and any solid surface using a Time-of-Flight (ToF) laser.

item.title: Operation
item.description:
Overview

Thingsee BEAM operates continuously once installed, automatically measuring distance to the target surface and reporting changes. The sensor uses Time-of-Flight (ToF) laser technology to provide accurate fill-level data for dispensers, bins, shelves, and other applications.

Automatic Operation

Once powered on and connected to the Wirepas mesh network, Thingsee BEAM:

  1. Measures distance every 5 minutes (default)
  2. Reports changes when the distance exceeds the configured threshold
  3. Sends periodic updates every hour regardless of changes
  4. Manages power automatically for optimal battery life
  5. Self-heals network connections after temporary disruptions

No manual intervention is required — the sensor operates autonomously.

item.title: Configuration
item.description:
Overview

Thingsee BEAM sensors are preconfigured from the factory with optimal default settings for most fill-level monitoring applications. Configuration changes are performed remotely by Haltian support.

To request configuration changes, contact support@haltian.com with your sensor IDs and desired settings.

Default Configuration

Parameter Default Value Purpose
Measurement interval 300 s (5 minutes) Distance sampling frequency
Report interval 3600 s (1 hour) Heartbeat if no change detected
Ranging mode Short range (40–1300 mm) Default measurement range
Ranging timing budget 50 ms Balance between accuracy and power
Ranging ROI X1=4, Y1=4, X2=11, Y2=11 Default beam width
Accelerometer Disabled Optional tilt detection
Temperature Disabled Optional temperature reporting
Network role Routing Participates in mesh routing

Configurable Parameters

Measurement and Reporting Intervals

Parameter Range Default Impact
Measurement interval 10 s – 24 h 300 s (5 min) How often the sensor measures distance
Report interval 600 s – 24 h 3600 s (1 hour) How often the sensor reports when no change detected

item.title: Data Output
item.description:
Overview

Thingsee BEAM produces measurement data that you can access through the Haltian IoT Platform — receive JSON measurements via MQTT Stream API or query via GraphQL Service API.

This page documents the measurement types, payload formats, and how to access the data.

Haltian IoT Measurements

The BEAM sensor produces the following measurement types:

Measurement Type Description
distance Distance to target surface in mm
batteryPercentage Remaining battery level
deviceOrientation Accelerometer data (when enabled)

distance

Reports the measured distance from the sensor to the nearest solid surface.

item.title: Specifications
item.description:
Product Overview

Model: Thingsee BEAM Product Code: TSTF04 Device Model: com.haltian.device.tstf04 Manufacturer: Haltian Oy, Finland Purpose: Wireless IoT sensor for short distance measurement using Time-of-Flight (ToF) laser

Distance Measurement Specifications

Specification Value
Technology Time-of-Flight (ToF) laser
Measurement Range 40–4000 mm
Short Range Mode 40–1300 mm
Long Range Mode Up to 4000 mm
Ranging Accuracy ±25 mm max
Beam Width (ROI) 15–27° adjustable cone
ROI Configuration 16×16 matrix, minimum 4×4
Installation Angle 90° recommended, ±6° adjustable
Minimum Distance 40 mm from target surface
Laser Class Class 1 (safe under all conditions of normal use)

Test conditions: Solid, matte, white surface at 140 mm reference distance.

item.title: Configuration Commands
item.description:
Overview

Thingsee BEAM is configured remotely through the Service API (GraphQL) — named commands with built-in validation and automatic encoding.

Configuration changes can also be requested via support@haltian.com if you do not have direct API access.

Service API Commands

The Service API provides named configuration commands that handle CBOR encoding, delivery, and validation automatically. Use these through the Service API (GraphQL).

Available Commands

Command Purpose Parameters
SetReportAndMeasurementInterval Set reporting and measurement frequency reportInterval, measurementInterval
GetReportAndMeasurementInterval Read current intervals —
SetDeviceConfiguration Set sensor-specific parameters rangingMode, rangingTimingBudget, rangingROI, accelerometer, temperature
GetDeviceConfiguration Read current device configuration —

SetReportAndMeasurementInterval

Configures how frequently the sensor takes measurements and reports data to the cloud.
